papers.title: Preparation and properties of Co–Cr alloy denture by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The selective laser melting (SLM) process of cobalt-chromium alloy and the effects of heat treatment were examined in this study to aid in the development of Co-Cr alloy personalized medical products. The Taguchi test was performed to determine the laser power, scanning speed, and hatch distance. The best process parameters were selected by using the highest density: the optimum hatch distance was 0.08 mm; the scanning speed was 1110 mm s−1; the laser power was 335 W; the energy density at this time was 4.8 J mm−2; and the density reached 99.18%. The hardness, tensile strength, and elongation of the Co-Cr alloys formed by SLM were 41.0 HRC, 1032 MPa, and 10%, respectively. Their original phases were mainly composed of γ(fcc) and ε(hcp) phases, and the alloy's microstructure consisted of fine equiaxed crystal and columnar crystal. The solution treatment process occurred in the γ → ε phase transition, and the solution-aging process also produced a strengthening phase M23C6 (M = Co, Cr, Mo, W). With the treatment in solution for 1 h at 1150 °C integrated with 2 h of aging at 800 °C, the hardness, tensile strength, and elongation were increased by 6.1%, 35.9%, and 17.6%, respectively, and fully met the requirements of ASTM F75. The bonding strength of the metal-ceramic joint was determined to be 94.3 MPa in a three-point bending experiment.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钴铬合金的SLM制备和力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与研究方向相关性较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM Biomedical Materials direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM钴铬合金工艺参数并研究热处理对性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用Taguchi实验设计优化激光参数，并进行固溶和时效处理
summary_zh.result: 最优参数下密度达99.18%，抗拉强度1032 MPa，热处理后强度提高35.9%
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度、硬度、拉伸和陶瓷结合强度测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To determine optimal SLM processing parameters for Co-Cr alloy and investigate the effect of heat treatment on mechanical properties for dental applications.
summary_en.method: Taguchi design was used to optimize laser power, scanning speed, and hatch distance; solution and aging treatments were applied.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters gave 99.18% density; as-built tensile strength of 1032 MPa; heat treatment increased strength by 35.9%.
summary_en.validation: Validation via density measurement, hardness, tensile tests, and three-point bending for metal-ceramic bonding.
